'''Slatstone''' was a type of material used in making buildings. The [[Morning Court]]&mdash;a large atrium in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], featured slatstone flooring.<ref name="inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
